notes:
**Piston numbers carry on from the last one you placed — on either tablet.** When you placed a piston on the second tablet, or right after deleting one, the next number could jump to one past the highest number in the piece (for example into the 800s on a 999-general organ) instead of following on from the piston you had just set. It now continues from the most recently placed or changed general, whichever tablet it was on.

If you use two tablets together, update both.
